CONTENTS

    LYRIC
    TALK

LYRIC

Again ye come, ye hovering Forms! I find ye,
As early to my clouded sight ye shone!
Shall I attempt, this once, to seize and bind ye?

And dear ones rise,
Whom fortune stole.

[Illustration]

TALK

A STAGE

MANAGER. POET.

MANAGER

Ye two, who oft my help have been,
Say, what think ye?
I wish to please the crowd,
Who live and let me live.
Already there they sit,
With curious eyebrows raised.

POET

Away, profane!

MANAGER (_softly_)

Hush, he hears. [_Exit_.

POET

My breast is pressed
Beneath such weight.27
(The evening comes),—

THE LORD

My servant! Tempt him.

MANAGER

Enough talk.

VOICE

The birds are still;
The night descends.

POET

I wake.

*** END OF THE PROJECT GUTENBERG EBOOK MINI ***
